purpose: Each row is a typed external datum the observed anchors require. Each column is a property of a candidate action. Each cell states what an action in class C must satisfy for that row to hold, with demand lineage from an observed anchor. Intersecting rows shrinks the region of admissible actions toward empty (falsification within C) or a candidate family (discovery).

cell_status_values.constrained: a requirement is derived; cites evidence
cell_status_values.decided_for_C: the cell is settled for every action in C (theorem or certified computation)
cell_status_values.gated: blocked on a named object; the gate is part of the cell
cell_status_values.empty: no action in C satisfies the cell

cells.requirement: No covariant interior operator of the Clifford-RS sector forces an odd chiral count, so P3 must enter as external background or boundary data rather than from the interior carrier.
cells.grade: linear leg theorem-grade; antilinear leg finite adversarial hunt (evidence, not proof)

cells.requirement: The RS boundary eta on RP^3 is 2-primary, so the boundary term does not source an order-3 count.
A families-pushforward index N over the metric fibre GL(4,R)/O(3,1) with N != 0 mod 3, without chi-import. Every honest value computed so far (-42, -672, -5376, 0) is 0 mod 3.
cells.gate: the K3-fibered vertical bundle with clutching, the a-priori Y14 boundary connection and the RS family symbol (interface items 1-4)
cells.gate_policy: Do not build the gate objects. Work the structural route instead.
cells.structural_route: Ask which structural property of class C forces the families index N to be 0 mod 3 or lets it avoid that: e.g. whether every admissible fibre family's index lands in the 2-primary arena of pi_3^s = Z/24 (as the boundary eta does), or whether an order-3 class can arise from the fibre GL(4,R)/O(3,1) topology at all. A proof either way decides the cell for C without any specific action.

cells.requirement: The physical gauge-fixed RS complex needs a stabilized RS-sector action; the gamma-trace constraint and the gauge orbit are incompatible as a naive quotient.
cells.gate_policy: Do not attempt to stabilize the RS-sector action. Work the structural route instead.
cells.structural_route: Classify, for the gauge structure of class C, whether any gauge-fixed RS complex compatible with the gamma-trace constraint exists (a cohomological obstruction question), rather than constructing one.

program_run_counter.rule: Every hourly run increments this in its postflight, whatever its lane. Lane C runs when count % 4 == 3 before the increment.

working_rule: Cells are worked at the structure level: a requirement must hold for every action in class C or for a structurally defined subfamily. No cell is worked by writing down a specific action, and no gated cell is worked by building its gate object. See CURRENT-STATE.yaml program_focus.structure_not_specifics.
